ayuda.en_linea: The GPS unit is reporting right now.
ayuda.desconectado: The GPS unit was reporting and stopped more than 5 minutes ago.
ayuda.incompleto: This vehicle still needs setup before it can report.
ayuda.sin_dato: No signal has arrived for this vehicle. It does not mean it is disconnected: it may have no GPS installed, or the position service may not be responding.

ayudaEquipo.sinDato: No signal has arrived from this unit. It does not mean it is disconnected: it may not have reported yet, or the position service may not be responding.
ayudaEquipo.sinDatoNoInstalado: This unit is not installed in any vehicle, so it has nothing to report from. Having no signal is expected: it is not a fault.

vacio.sinFuente: No vehicle is in that connection state right now. Either none is, or the signal is not arriving: the vehicles are still there.
vacio.incompleto: This filter returns nothing yet: Fleet does not flag vehicles as “Incomplete” so far.

vacioEquipo.sinFuente: No unit is in that connection state right now. Either none is, or the signal is not arriving: the units are still in your inventory.
vacioEquipo.incompleto: This filter does not apply to units: “Incomplete” describes a vehicle without a device. To find units without a vehicle, use Assignment.

datosParciales.descripcion_one: No signal for the only row on this page. It may have no GPS installed, or the position service may not be responding. Everything else is up to date.
datosParciales.descripcion_other: No signal for any of the {{count}} rows on this page. They may have no GPS installed, or the position service may not be responding. Everything else is up to date.

filtros.situacionAyuda: It comes from the current Fleet assignments, not from the GPS signal: it stays accurate even with no connection data.

celda.dispositivoSinComponer: Fleet does not show the GPS from the vehicle yet. The installed device is visible in the device inventory.
celda.conductorSinComponer: Fleet does not show the driver from the vehicle yet. The current assignment is visible on the driver profile.

rutaNoEncontrada.titulo: This Fleet section does not exist

comun.noSePuedeBorrar: Clearing a field does not delete it yet: {{campos}} will stay as they were. The rest of your changes are saved.

forbidden.descripcion: You need this permission to see this screen.

ubicacion.mapaPendiente: This card does not draw the map: it shows when the last signal arrived.

conductor.vacioTitulo: We cannot show this vehicle's drivers
conductor.vacioDescripcion: Fleet does not compose this information on the vehicle side yet, so it stays empty even when the vehicle has an assigned driver. The current assignment is visible on the driver page.
conductor.quitarSinId: Removing the driver needs the assignment made in this session. If someone else assigned it, remove it from the driver profile.
conductor.recienAsignadoDescripcion: The assignment was saved. The person details are on their profile: Fleet does not compose them on the vehicle side yet.

dispositivo.snapshotPendiente: Live technical status (connection, battery, last signal) is shown on the device page, not here.
dispositivo.desasociarSinId: Unlinking needs the link identifier, and today it only arrives in the response of linking: it is available if you linked it in this session. In the meantime, use Change device.
dispositivo.sinComponerTitulo: This page does not show the vehicle GPS yet
dispositivo.sinComponerDescripcion: Fleet does not compose the installed device here yet, so this screen cannot confirm whether the vehicle has one. The device inventory does show it, in its Vehicle column. You can link one anyway: if it already had one, the previous unit goes back to stock.
dispositivo.recienAsociadoDescripcion: The link was saved. The unit details are not shown on this page yet because the vehicle does not compose them; the device page has them in full.
dispositivo.identificacionRecienAsociado: The device you linked in this session

historial.degradadoDescripcion: Trip history has no data source yet: historical vehicle positions are not stored. This does not mean the vehicle has not been driven.
historial.errorTitulo: The history could not be loaded
historial.errorDescripcion: Try again in a few seconds.

editar.aliasAyuda: Operational nickname for the vehicle inside your organization.
editar.leyendaCanonicos: Plate, make, model, year and type are edited in the vehicle's canonical record, not here.

baja.descripcion: The vehicle stops appearing in lists and on the map.
baja.bloqueadaPorAsignaciones: The vehicle cannot be deleted: it still has a driver or a device assigned. Unassign them first.

onboarding.subtitulo: Start tracking your fleet in minutes. Once you add the first one you will see the live map and alerts in your dashboard.
onboarding.vehiculoCreado: Done: vehicle {{patente}} is already created and you can look it up even if you leave this wizard.
onboarding.saltarAlDashboard: Skip this step — go to the dashboard

catalogo.fallo: The catalog could not be loaded. Try again in a few seconds.

catalogo.tiposVacios: The vehicle type catalog is still empty.

errores.sinFilaFantasma: No vehicle was created: you can retry without risk of duplicating it.

asignacionConductor.descripcion: Pick a driver from your organization for this vehicle.

asignacionConductor.cambiarDescripcion: You are about to replace the driver assigned to this vehicle.
asignacionConductor.cambiarNoAtomico: The change takes two steps: the current driver is removed first and the new one is assigned after. If the second step fails, the vehicle is left without a driver.
asignacionConductor.desasignarDescripcion: You are about to remove {{nombre}} from this vehicle. History is kept.

asignacionConductor.noAvisaAlConductor: The assignment does not notify the driver.
asignacionConductor.errorElegirOtro: That driver cannot be assigned right now. Pick another one or review their status and license.
asignacionConductor.errorConflicto: The assignment changed while you were filling the form. Refresh and try again.
asignacionConductor.errorNoEncontrado: We could not find that driver or assignment. Refresh the screen.
asignacionConductor.errorGenerico: We could not complete the operation. Check the current state before retrying.
asignacionConductor.cambioAMediasTitulo: The vehicle was left without a driver
asignacionConductor.cambioAMedias: {{nombre}} was removed but the new driver was not assigned. Try the assignment again: the removal step is not repeated.

vinculoDispositivoConductor.sinDisponibles: There are no devices to link.
vinculoDispositivoConductor.atribucionAviso: Linking a device does not install it on a vehicle nor change its inventory status.
vinculoDispositivoConductor.cerrarDescripcion: You are about to close the link with {{dispositivo}}. History is kept.

asignacionVehiculo.descripcion: Pick a vehicle from your organization for this driver.
asignacionVehiculo.sinDisponibles: There are no active vehicles in your organization.
asignacionVehiculo.buscarPlaceholder: Search by plate, alias, make or model
asignacionVehiculo.soloPrimeros: Showing the first {{cantidad}} of {{total}}. If you cannot find the vehicle, look it up from the list.
asignacionVehiculo.sinPermisoLectura: You need the {{permiso}} permission to see the vehicle list.
asignacionVehiculo.noLiberaElActual: This does NOT release the vehicle they already drive: it adds an assignment. To close the previous one, use "Remove" on the Assignments tab.
asignacionVehiculo.listaSinFiltrar: Every active vehicle is listed, including those that already have a driver: one with a secondary driver can still take a primary. If the one you pick already has a primary driver, the assignment is rejected on save.
asignacionVehiculo.sinDisponiblesSinDispositivo: Every active vehicle already has a GPS unit installed. You can unlink one, or add the vehicle that is missing.
asignacionVehiculo.listaFiltradaSinDispositivo: Only active vehicles with no GPS installed are listed. The server resolves that filter over the current links: if the one you want is missing, it already has a unit.

asignacionAVehiculo.descripcion: Pick the vehicle this unit will be installed in. It moves to «Installed» and its positions start counting for that vehicle.
